question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` and `defaultAccount` as the supported multi-bot configuration contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but it creates a broad public setup, routing, credential, authorization, and persisted-state model whose permanent support requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the account model
options.body: Accept the standard account/default/binding shape after unrelated-scope cleanup and exact-head compatibility review.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land core account routing first and defer advanced Graph, SSO, setup, or persisted-state support to follow-up changes.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Keep Microsoft Teams single-account and close this PR and the canonical feature request.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the account model
recommendation.body: Accept the standard account/default/binding shape after unrelated-scope cleanup and exact-head compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent cross-cutting Teams and config history and are the best available owner for the public compatibility decision.
